entity.every_tunnel.subject: Test Subject
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_01_1: Oh. You're early. Sit down, mind the papers.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_02_1: You're the new one, right? Fourteen.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_02_2: Good with cameras, your file said.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_03_1: I've been up here a long time.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_03_2: I lost count of the coffees a while ago.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_04_1: There used to be a cafeteria on the third floor.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_05_1: Anyway. After what happened down here, head office came by with a tablet.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_05_2: Said the lower labs were no longer their concern.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_06_1: It gets hot under this thing.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_07_1: I kept the project going after they left.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_07_2: Seemed rude to stop in the middle of it.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_08_1: A few months later I needed someone inside.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_08_2: Night shift, a few cameras, quick money.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_09_1: The guard before you stayed too.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_09_2: Nobody ever told him he could go home.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_10_1: Nobody told you what the company built down here.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_11_1: The tests started small. Plants. Mice.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_11_2: Then I ran out of mice.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_12_3: Four rooms down the east corridor.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_13_1: By the fourth room they'd stopped answering to their names.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_14_1: The grey clouds came after that.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_14_3: If one shows up, turn around and walk back the way you came.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_15_1: The little ones just follow them around.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_15_2: Look them in the eye if you want.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_16_1: I'd say sorry about the ad, but you'd see right through me.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_16_2: So. Thank you for your service.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_17_1: That's about everything. You should go.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.boss_19_2: I hope you haven't met before.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.loop_1_1: Did you hear me? The door's right there.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.loop_3_1: I can't help you any further.
subtitle.every_tunnel.director.loop_4_1: You're standing very still. Are you alright?
terminal.every_tunnel.office.title: LOWER LABS - WORK LOG
terminal.every_tunnel.office.day_1: Day 1. Head office came down with a tablet. The budget for the lower labs is gone. End of the month. Staff to leave.
terminal.every_tunnel.office.day_30: Day 30. They have left. I have kept the schedule. It seemed rude to stop in the middle.
terminal.every_tunnel.office.day_41_drai: Day 41. The chemical room's drain backed up. I sealed it with a grate.
terminal.every_tunnel.office.day_41_mix: To open it: R-%1$s with R-%2$s in the mixer. Nothing else.
terminal.every_tunnel.office.day_41_alar: The wrong pair sets off the alarm. The alarm brings them.
terminal.every_tunnel.office.day_77: Day 77. Something in the Lab hall again. Do not look at it. Turn round, walk back the way you came. It goes.
terminal.every_tunnel.storage.title: STORAGE - INVENTORY

screen.every_tunnel.congrats.title: Congratulations
screen.every_tunnel.congrats.text:
You made it to the end of Every Tunnel.
Thank you for spending the night shift down here, in the dark, listening to every step. This game was made for exactly that, and you saw it through.
I hope the Noname Complex stays with you for a while. Thank you for playing.
- Daio7771
